title: Credo (Hesdin, Missa Hic est vere martir)
desc: Nicolle des Celliers de Hesdin, Missa Hic est vere martir, Credo, 1534-1535. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
